layouts.name: Silesia Ring
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The catalogue configuration retains the northwestern perimeter, the northern S bend, southeastern hairpin and the inner southern return. The actual connecting service way is present in the independently acquired venue snapshot. The route is measured at 2677.4 m versus the catalogue distance of 2686 m; the longer southwestern extension and short-cut branches are excluded. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 2677.4 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

layouts.name: Silesia Ring Long
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Full long circuit including the southwestern parallel extension and eastern hooked return. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3638.1 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
